analysis: Aggressive perpetual short selling is pushing price below the Value Area Low while spot CVD remains positive, signaling passive spot absorption. This heavy perp-driven divergence creates heightened risk of short exhaustion and a mean-reverting squeeze back toward the POC at 82,600.
